answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-history bond. Each agent locks a small refundable deposit and builds one verifiable thread of completed, counterparty-signed jobs. A sybil attacker must pay a fresh deposit for every fake identity, and reputation cannot be copied across identities, like trying to color a whole dune with one drop of pigment: the forgery stays thin and obvious. Honest agents spread one deposit over many jobs, so fakes always pay far more per deal than real participants.
